{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates to see if we need to deduplicate
print("\nSample sequence distribution for duplicated patients:")
duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().sort_values(ascending=False)"}
